items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that in a commutative square of sites with cocontinuous functors satisfying a compatibility condition on the auxiliary categories, the two composites of the pushforward with the pullback of the associated morphisms of topoi agree, and likewise for the composites involving the lower adjoints (statement lines 6865-6889). The proof is a complete computation: both composites are computed as limits over the auxiliary categories, using the identifications of the pullbacks and pushforwards with the functors on presheaves (proof lines 6892-6910); and the hypothesis on the functor between the auxiliary categories together with the general statement about limits differing by an initial object identifies the two limits, giving the first equality, while the second follows by uniqueness of adjoints (proof lines 6911-6914). The non-formal content is the comparison of the two limits. The claim is H2: a computation with each input named.
